lines.gurmukhi: ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਸਭ ਭਵਿ ਥਕੀ ਕਿਨਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jug chaare sabh bhav thakee kin keemat hoee ||
lines.translation: All have grown weary of wandering throughout the four ages, but none know the Lord's worth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਵਿਖਾਲਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur ek vikhaaliaa man tan sukh hoee ||
lines.translation: The True Guru has shown me the One Lord, and my mind and body are at peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh sadaa salaaheeai karataa kare s hoee ||7||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh praises the Lord forever; that alone happens, which the Creator Lord does. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mahalaa 2 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Second Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਭਉ ਤਿਨੑ ਨਾਹਿ ਭਉ ਮੁਚੁ ਭਉ ਨਿਭਵਿਆਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinaa bhau tinh naahi bhau much bhau nibhaviaah ||
lines.translation: Those who have the Fear of God, have no other fears; those who do not have the Fear of God, are very afraid.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਹੁ ਪਟੰਤਰਾ ਤਿਤੁ ਦੀਬਾਣਿ ਗਇਆਹ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak ehu pata(n)taraa tit deebaan gaiaah ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, this mystery is revealed at the Court of the Lord. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 2 ||
lines.translation: Second Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਰਦੇ ਕਉ ਤੁਰਦਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਉਡਤੇ ਕਉ ਉਡਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: turade kau turadaa milai udate kau udataa ||
lines.translation: That which flows, mingles with that which flows; that which blows, mingles with that which blows.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤੇ ਕਉ ਜੀਵਤਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਮੂਏ ਕਉ ਮੂਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeevate kau jeevataa milai mooe kau mooaa ||
lines.translation: The living mingle with the living, and the dead mingle with the dead.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕੀਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak so saalaaheeai jin kaaran keeaa ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, praise the One who created the creation. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਸੇ ਸਚੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach dhiaain se sache gur sabad veechaaree ||
lines.translation: Those who meditate on the True Lord are true; they contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai maar man niramalaa har naam ur dhaaree ||
lines.translation: They subdue their ego, purify their minds, and enshrine the Lord's Name within their hearts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਠੇ ਮੰਡਪ ਮਾੜੀਆ ਲਗਿ ਪਏ ਗਾਵਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kothe ma(n)dap maaReeaa lag pae gaavaaree ||
lines.translation: The fools are attached to their homes, mansions and balconies.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑਿ ਕੀਏ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਬਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinhi keee tisahi na jaananee manamukh gubaaree ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are caught in darkness; they do not know the One who created them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਬੁਝਾਇਹਿ ਸੋ ਬੁਝਸੀ ਸਚਿਆ ਕਿਆ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰੀ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: jis bujhaaihi so bujhasee sachiaa kiaa ja(n)t vichaaree ||8||
lines.translation: He alone understands, whom the True Lord causes to understand; what can the helpless creatures do? ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਤਉ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਕੰਤੁ ਮਨਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaaman tau seegaar kar jaa pahilaa(n) ka(n)t manaai ||
lines.translation: O bride, decorate yourself, after you surrender and accept your Husband Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਤੁ ਸੇਜੈ ਕੰਤੁ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਏਵੈ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mat sejai ka(n)t na aavaee evai birathaa jaai ||
lines.translation: Otherwise, your Husband Lord will not come to your bed, and your ornaments will be useless.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਪਿਰ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਤਉ ਬਣਿਆ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaaman pir man maaniaa tau baniaa seegaar ||
lines.translation: O bride, your decorations will adorn you, only when your Husband Lord's Mind is pleased.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੀਆ ਤਉ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਸਹੁ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: keeaa tau paravaan hai jaa sahu dhare piaar ||
lines.translation: Your ornaments will be acceptable and approved, only when your Husband Lord loves you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਉ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਤਬੋਲ ਰਸੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਭਾਉ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhau seegaar tabol ras bhojan bhaau karei ||
lines.translation: So make the Fear of God your ornaments, joy your betel nuts to chew, and love your food.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਉਪੇ ਕੰਤ ਕਉ ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਭੋਗੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tan man saupe ka(n)t kau tau naanak bhog karei ||1||
lines.translation: Surrender your body and mind to your Husband Lord, and then, O Nanak, He will enjoy you. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਜਲ ਫੂਲ ਤੰਬੋਲ ਰਸੁ ਲੇ ਧਨ ਕੀਆ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaajal phool ta(n)bol ras le dhan keeaa seegaar ||
lines.translation: The wife takes flowers, and fragrance of betel, and decorates herself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਜੈ ਕੰਤੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਏਵੈ ਭਇਆ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sejai ka(n)t na aaio evai bhaiaa vikaar ||2||
lines.translation: But her Husband Lord does not come to her bed, and so these efforts are useless. ||2||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਪਿਰੁ ਏਹਿ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਨਿ ਬਹਨਿ ਇਕਠੇ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhan pir ehi na aakheean bahan ikathe hoi ||
lines.translation: They are not said to be husband and wife, who merely sit together.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਜੋਤਿ ਦੁਇ ਮੂਰਤੀ ਧਨ ਪਿਰੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ek jot dui mooratee dhan pir kaheeai soi ||3||
lines.translation: They alone are called husband and wife, who have one light in two bodies. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhai bin bhagat na hovaee naam na lagai piaar ||
lines.translation: Without the Fear of God, there is no devotional worship, and no love for the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਭਉ ਊਪਜੈ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਰੰਗੁ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur miliai bhau oopajai bhai bhaai ra(n)g savaar ||
lines.translation: Meeting with the True Guru, the Fear of God wells up, and one is embellished with the Fear and the Love of God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: tan man rataa ra(n)g siu haumai trisanaa maar ||
lines.translation: When the body and mind are imbued with the Lord's Love, egotism and desire are conquered and subdued.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਅਤਿ ਸੋਹਣਾ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan niramal at sohanaa bhetiaa krisan muraar ||
lines.translation: The mind and body become immaculately pure and very beautiful, when one meets the Lord, the Destroyer of ego.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਉ ਭਾਉ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: bhau bhaau sabh tis daa so sach varatai sa(n)saar ||9||
lines.translation: Fear and love all belong to Him; He is the True Lord, permeating and pervading the Universe. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਖਸਮ ਤੂ ਵਾਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਿ ਰਚਨਾ ਹਮ ਕੀਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaahu khasam too vaahu jin rach rachanaa ham keee ||
lines.translation: Waaho! Waaho! You are wonderful and great, O Lord and Master; You created the creation, and made us.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਗਰ ਲਹਰਿ ਸਮੁੰਦ ਸਰ ਵੇਲਿ ਵਰਸ ਵਰਾਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: saagar lahar samu(n)d sar vel varas varaahu ||
lines.translation: You made the waters, waves, oceans, pools, plants, clouds and mountains.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਖੜੋਵਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਿ ਆਪੀਣੈ ਆਪਾਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap khaRovahi aap kar aapeenai aapaahu ||
lines.translation: You Yourself stand in the midst of what You Yourself created.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਥਾਇ ਪਵੈ ਉਨਮਨਿ ਤਤੁ ਕਮਾਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh sevaa thaai pavai unaman tat kamaahu ||
lines.translation: The selfless service of the Gurmukhs is approved; in celestial peace, they live the essence of reality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਸਕਤਿ ਲਹਹੁ ਮਜੂਰੀਆ ਮੰਗਿ ਮੰਗਿ ਖਸਮ ਦਰਾਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: masakat lahahu majooreeaa ma(n)g ma(n)g khasam daraahu ||
lines.translation: They receive the wages of their labor, begging at the Door of their Lord and Master.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੁਰ ਦਰ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹ ਤਉ ਦਰਿ ਊਣਾ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋ ਸਚਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak pur dar veparavaah tau dar oonaa naahi ko sachaa veparavaahu ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Court of the Lord is overflowing and carefree; O my True Carefree Lord, no one returns empty-handed from Your Court. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਜਲ ਮੋਤੀ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਰਤਨਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਜੁੜੰਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ujal motee sohane ratanaa naal juRa(n)n ||
lines.translation: The teeth are like brilliant, beautiful pearls, and the eyes are like sparkling jewels.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਜਰੁ ਵੈਰੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿ ਬੁਢੇ ਥੀਇ ਮਰੰਨਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: tin jar vairee naanakaa j budhe theei mara(n)n ||2||
lines.translation: Old age is their enemy, O Nanak; when they grow old, they waste away. ||2||
